name: MINE_ST_SAFE
meaning: DefusableMine: defused or carried (pickup prompt); no base action

name: MINE_ST_REARMING
meaning: deadline = now + 5 s; DefusableMine returns to 2 once the deadline has passed AND it is in the dormant half

name: MINE_ST_ARMED
meaning: armed: proximity/region check (subclass); msg 0 arg 0 starts a countdown

name: MINE_ST_COUNTDOWN
meaning: deadline = now + 0x2aa (0.1665 s); GroundMine proximity trigger overrides it with fuseDelay and can cancel back to 2

name: MINE_ST_EXPLODING
meaning: exploded model + anim 0, shadow hidden, MSG_KILL broadcasts (300 any class, 550 Rocks), camera shake

name: MINE_ST_EXPLODED
meaning: explosion anim finished. GroundMine stays here until Reset; DefusableMine waits 20 s, resets, goes to 1

name: DM_ST_PLAYBACK
meaning: DefusableMine: shows the code one symbol per step (Ralph frozen via msg 0xe)

name: DM_ST_INPUT
meaning: DefusableMine: the player repeats the code on the beat; success -> 0, any miss -> 4
